No authenticated CN game build is available. Every record, field and relation remains reference, missing or conflict; none is a verified CN mechanic
Garland core reports 7.5; this is not an authenticated CN build. Public detail URLs cannot be version-pinned; raw hashes and retrieval times are retained
User-reported Web HTTP 403; Huiji was not re-probed, mirrored, proxied, or bypassed
Garland action browse has no trait records; Trait names and descriptions use pinned international English references. No trait IDs were guessed into action URLs
Full Chinese status name index was attempted; Chinese status detail descriptions were not collected. International Status descriptions are reference-only
Status category membership is an applicability reference, not proof of a job granting or owning a status. Generic statuses are retained once in the shared status library
Non-player job-associated actions are retained as reference. Pet ownership and player/variant distinctions are not guessed from names or numeric ranges
Replacement types, charge traits, song and dance rules, proc conditions, shared cooldown semantics and resource rules require manual review; no description is parsed into executable mechanics

Garland browse job is only a selection hint, not confirmation of ClassJob ownership or base-class inheritance. Index-only and replacement-only candidates remain disabled; ownership interpretation disagreements are explicit conflicts, even when a broad category allows the job

AozAction.Action joins AozActionTransient.Number by row_id at the pinned international version/schema. Aoz row IDs, Action IDs and spellbook numbers are distinct identifiers, not authenticated CN unlock or active-spell state
18 named international statuses are absent from the Chinese index
1058 empty/unnamed status rows remain in the raw table cache and are not given invented display names

traits.name: Melee Mastery
traits.description: Increases the potency of Slice to 300, Waxing Slice to 140, Shadow of Death to 300, Harpe to 300, Spinning Scythe to 140, Infernal Slice to 140, Whorl of Death to 100, and Nightmare Scythe to 120.

traits.name: Enhanced Avatar
traits.description:
Grants the effect of Soul Reaver upon successfully landing Blood Stalk or Grim Swathe.
Duration: 30s
Effect ends upon execution of any weaponskill or magic attack.

traits.name: Hellsgate
traits.description:
Upon executing Hell's Ingress or Hell's Egress, leave behind a Hellsgate and grant Threshold to self.
Duration: 10s
Hell's Ingress changes to Regress after executing Hell's Egress, and vice versa.

traits.name: Tempered Soul
traits.description:
Allows the accumulation of charges for consecutive uses of Soul Slice and Soul Scythe.
Maximum Charges: 2

traits.name: Shroud Gauge
traits.description: Allows for Shroud Gauge accumulation upon the landing of Gibbet, Gallows, or Guillotine.

traits.name: Enhanced Arcane Crest
traits.description:
Grants Crest of Time Returned to self and nearby party members, gradually restoring HP over time. This effect is only granted when the Crest of Time Borrowed barrier is completely absorbed.
Cure Potency: 50
Duration: 15s

traits.name: Void Soul
traits.description: Grants Void Shroud upon landing Void Reaping, Cross Reaping, or Grim Reaping.

traits.name: Enhanced Arcane Circle
traits.description:
Grants Circle of Sacrifice to you and nearby party members upon executing Arcane Circle.
Duration: 5s
When you or party members under this effect successfully land a weaponskill or cast a spell, you may gain a stack of Immortal Sacrifice, up to a maximum of 8.
Duration: 30s
Also grants Bloodsown Circle to self, allowing you to receive stacks of Immortal Sacrifice from party members under the effect of your Circle of Sacrifice.
Duration: 6s

traits.name: Melee Mastery II
traits.description: Increases the potency of Slice to 320, Waxing Slice to 160, and Infernal Slice to 180.

traits.name: Enhanced Enshroud
traits.description:
Grants Oblatio upon executing Enshroud.
Duration: 30s

traits.name: Enhanced Gluttony
traits.description:
Grants 2 stacks of Executioner upon executing Gluttony.
Duration: 30s
Effect cannot be stacked with Soul Reaver.
Effect ends upon execution of any weaponskill or magic attack.
Gibbet changes to Executioner's Gibbet, Gallows changes to Executioner's Gallows, and Guillotine changes to Executioner's Guillotine while under the effect of Executioner.

traits.name: Enhanced Plentiful Harvest
traits.description:
Grants Perfectio Occulta upon executing Plentiful Harvest.
Duration: 30s
Perfectio Occulta changes to Perfectio Parata upon executing Communio.
Effect of Perfectio Parata ends upon gaining the effect of Lemure Shroud.

traits.name: Viper's Fangs
traits.description:
Allows the execution of Death Rattle.
Can only be executed upon successfully landing Flanksting Strike, Flanksbane Fang, Hindsting Strike, or Hindsbane Fang.

traits.name: Viper's Maw
traits.description:
Allows the execution of Last Lash.
Can only be executed after successfully landing Jagged Maw or Bloodied Maw.

traits.name: Viper's Bite
traits.description:
Allows the execution of Twinfang Bite and Twinblood Bite.
Can only be executed after successfully landing Hunter's Coil or Swiftskin's Coil.

traits.name: Viper's Thresh
traits.description:
Allows the execution of Twinfang Thresh and Twinblood Thresh.
Can only be executed after successfully landing Hunter's Den or Swiftskin's Den.

traits.name: Viper's Rattle
traits.description: Grants 1 stack of Rattling Coil upon successfully landing Vicewinder or Vicepit.

traits.name: Enhanced Slither
traits.description: Allows a third charge of Slither.

traits.name: Enhanced Viper's Rattle
traits.description: Allows the stacking of a third Rattling Coil.

traits.name: Serpent's Lineage
traits.description:
Allows for Serpent Offerings Gauge accumulation upon the landing of certain actions.
Furthermore, adds an additional effect to Serpent's Ire that grants Ready to Reawaken.
Duration: 30s

traits.name: Uncoiled Fangs
traits.description: Allows the execution of Uncoiled Twinfang or Uncoiled Twinblood after successfully landing Uncoiled Fury.

traits.name: Enhanced Serpent's Lineage
traits.description:
Allows the stacking of a fifth Anguine Tribute in the Serpent Offerings Gauge.
Furthermore, allows the execution of Ouroboros while under the effect of Reawakened.

traits.name: Serpent's Legacy
traits.description: Allows the execution of First Legacy after successfully landing First Generation, Second Legacy after successfully landing Second Generation, Third Legacy after successfully landing Third Generation, and Fourth Legacy after successfully landing Fourth Generation.

traits.name: Melee Mastery
traits.description: Increases the potency of Steel Fangs to 200, Reaving Fangs to 200, Hunter's Sting to 300, and Swiftskin's Sting to 300.

traits.name: Melee Mastery II
traits.description: Increases the potency of Flanksting Strike, Flanksbane Fang, Hindsting Strike, and Hindsbane Fang to 340.

traits.name: Umbral Heart

traits.name: Aspect Mastery
traits.description:
Casting of certain fire and ice spells will grant a stack of Astral Fire and Umbral Ice respectively.
Maximum Stacks: 1
While under the effect of Astral Fire, the potency of Fire spells is increased by 40%, the cost of casting Fire spells is doubled, MP recovery is reduced to 0, and the potency of Ice spells is reduced by 10%.
While under the effect of Umbral Ice, the cost of casting Ice spells is reduced to 0, 2,500 MP is recovered upon landing an Ice spell, and the potency of Fire spells is reduced by 10%.

traits.name: Enhanced Polyglot
traits.description: Allows the stacking of a second Polyglot.

traits.name: Enhanced Enochian II
traits.description: Improves Enochian's magic damage increase to 15%.

traits.name: Aspect Mastery II
traits.description:
Allows the stacking of a second Astral Fire and Umbral Ice.
While under the effect of Astral Fire, the potency of Fire spells is increased by 60% and the potency of Ice spells is reduced by 20%.
While under the effect of Umbral Ice, 5,000 MP is recovered upon landing an Ice spell and the potency of Fire spells is reduced by 20%.

traits.name: Aspect Mastery III
traits.description:
Allows the stacking of a third Astral Fire and Umbral Ice.
Casting Fire II or Blizzard II grants maximum stacks of Astral Fire or Umbral Ice respectively.
While under the effect of Astral Fire III, the potency of Fire spells is increased by 80%, and the cast time of Ice spells is halved and potency lowered by 30%.
While under the effect of Umbral Ice III, 10,000 MP is recovered upon landing an Ice spell, and the cast time of Fire spells is halved and potency lowered by 30%.

traits.name: Enochian
traits.description: Increases damage dealt by 5% while under the effect of Astral Fire or Umbral Ice.

traits.name: Enhanced Foul
traits.description: Allows for the immediate casting of Foul.

traits.name: Aspect Mastery IV
traits.description: Upgrades Fire II and Blizzard II to High Fire II and High Blizzard II.

traits.name: Enhanced Manafont
traits.description: Reduces Manafont recast time to 100 seconds.

traits.name: Aspect Mastery V
traits.description:
Adds a Paradox marker to your Elemental Gauge.
The marker is made active after reaching Astral Fire III then swapping to the opposite element. Conversely, the marker can also be made active after reaching Umbral Ice III and gaining 3 Umbral Hearts then swapping to the opposite element. The marker is made inactive when the effect of Astral Fire or Umbral Ice expires.
Fire and Blizzard become Paradox when the Paradox marker is made active.

traits.name: Enhanced Jolt
traits.description: Upgrades Jolt to Jolt II. Also increases the potency of Verthunder and Veraero to 360, and the potency of Verfire and Verstone to 300.

traits.name: Maim and Mend
traits.description: Increases base action damage and HP restoration by 10%.

traits.name: Maim and Mend II
traits.description: Increases base action damage and HP restoration by 30%.

traits.name: Dualcast
traits.description:
Grants the effect of Dualcast upon casting any spell with a cast time. While under the effect of Dualcast, your next spell will require no time to cast. Effect is canceled upon execution of any action other than an ability. Auto-attacks do not cancel effect.
Duration: 15s

traits.name: Scatter Mastery
traits.description: Upgrades Scatter to Impact.

traits.name: Enhanced Displacement
traits.description: Increases Displacement and Engagement potency to 180.

traits.name: Red Magic Mastery
traits.description: Reduces Contre Sixte recast timer to 35 seconds and increases the potency of both Verthunder II and Veraero II to 120.

traits.name: Mana Stack
traits.description:
Adds a Mana Stack to your Balance Gauge upon landing Enchanted Riposte, Enchanted Zwerchhau, Enchanted Redoublement, Enchanted Moulinet, Enchanted Moulinet Deux, or Enchanted Moulinet Trois, up to a maximum of 3.
Upon gaining 3 Mana Stacks, Verthunder and Verthunder II are upgraded to Verflare.
Upon learning Verholy, gaining 3 Mana Stacks also upgrades Veraero and Veraero II to Verholy.

traits.name: Red Magic Mastery II
traits.description:
Upgrades Verthunder to Verthunder III and Veraero to Veraero III.
Upon gaining 3 Mana Stacks, Verthunder III is upgraded to Verflare and Veraero III is upgraded to Verholy.

traits.name: Red Magic Mastery III
traits.description: Upgrades Jolt II to Jolt III. Also increases the potency of Enchanted Riposte to 280, Verthunder II to 140, Veraero II to 140, Verfire to 340, Verstone to 340, Enchanted Zwerchhau to 150, Enchanted Redoublement to 130, Impact to 210, and Enchanted Reprise to 340.

traits.name: Enhanced Acceleration
traits.description:
Allows the accumulation of charges for consecutive uses of Acceleration.
Maximum Charges: 2

traits.name: Enhanced Embolden
traits.description:
Grants Thorned Flourish upon executing Embolden.
Duration: 30s

traits.name: Enhanced Acceleration II
traits.description:
Grants Grand Impact Ready upon executing Acceleration.
Duration: 30s
Jolt III and Impact change to Grand Impact while under the effect of Grand Impact Ready.

traits.name: Enhanced Manafication
traits.description:
Grants Prefulgence Ready upon executing Manafication.
Duration: 30s
Manafication changes to Prefulgence while under the effect of Prefulgence Ready.

traits.name: Enchanted Blade Mastery
traits.description: Increases the potency of Enchanted Riposte to 340, Verfire to 380, Verstone to 380, Enchanted Zwerchhau to 190, Fleche to 480, Enchanted Redoublement to 190, Contre Sixte to 420, Verflare to 650, Verholy to 650, Enchanted Reprise to 420, Scorch to 750, Veraero III to 440, Verthunder III to 440, and Resolution to 850.
